verdict_reason: Removing the contact handshake tests is correct for the AC and the select landing test now matches the controller's fixed redirect to the addresses page, but the helpers keep a fulfilmentId parameter that no remaining test uses.

todos.issue: With the contact tests gone, the fulfilmentId parameters on partyPagePath (line 32), handshakeQuery (line 39), returnedQuery (line 44) and handshakeState (line 50) are never given anything but consignor.id: every caller uses the default (handshakeQuery() at 172/232/430/446, returnedQuery(landing) throughout, handshakeState() throughout). The helpers still read as if the file drives several parties' handshakes, which only the removed contactAddress cases did.
todos.fix: Must: the test helpers take only the inputs the remaining tests vary, so no helper offers a party choice that no test uses. One way: drop the fulfilmentId parameter from handshakeQuery, returnedQuery and handshakeState (use consignor.id inside), and fold partyPagePath into consignorPicker.
